properties.displayName: Entra - Credential Added to Application or Service Principal
properties.description:
DETECTS
Entra ID audit events where credentials are added to an application or service principal, or where such an object is created or updated.

WHY IT MATTERS
Adding a client secret or certificate to an existing application is the most reliable identity persistence technique in Entra ID (MITRE T1098, Account Manipulation). The credential inherits every permission already granted to that application, survives user password resets, and is not protected by MFA. An attacker reaching Application Administrator uses this to retain access indefinitely.

TRIAGE
1. Enumerate the target application granted API permissions. Application-level Graph permissions such as Directory.ReadWrite.All or Mail.Read are critical.
2. Confirm the actor is authorised to manage application credentials.
3. Determine whether the application is business-critical or an unfamiliar, newly created object.
4. Check the credential validity period. An unusually long expiry is a persistence signal.
5. Correlate with SigninLogs for the actor to establish whether that identity was compromised first.
6. If unauthorized: remove the credential, review the application sign-in activity, revoke the actor sessions.

FALSE POSITIVES
Routine secret rotation and legitimate application onboarding. Tune by excluding known admins performing scheduled rotation, or alert only on applications holding high-privilege permissions.

SOURCE
AuditLogs
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Update application", "Update service principal", "Add service principal credentials", "Add application")
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorApp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| extend Initiator = coalesce(Actor, ActorApp)
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend TargetApp = tostring(TargetResources.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, Initiator, TargetApp, OperationName, Result, CorrelationId
| extend Account = Initiator

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Initiator}} performed {{OperationName}} against application or service principal {{TargetApp}}, potentially establishing durable persistence.
